summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $1,500,000,000 offering of 7.625% perpetual subordinated contingent convertible securities, callable during any optional redemption period. Interest is payable semi-annually from the expected November 13, 2026 issue date, with a first reset on May 13, 2032, thereafter resetting every five years at the relevant reference rate plus 3.004%; coupons are cancellable at the issuer's discretion. The notes are perpetual with no fixed maturity and convert automatically on a Capital Adequacy Trigger Event. This is an ordinary bank capital issuance, not a special situation; watch coupon-cancellation risk, trigger-conversion terms, and reset/residual-call mechanics.
